answer.en: No, hazelnuts are best kept away from cats. Cat-care guides warn that nuts can cause problems for cats, and most nuts are very fatty and can cause vomiting and diarrhoea.
answer.sl: Ne, lešnikov mački raje ne dajajte. Vodniki o negi mačk opozarjajo, da oreščki mačkam lahko povzročajo težave, večina oreščkov pa je zelo mastnih in lahko povzroči bruhanje in drisko.

why.en: Our sources do not single out this nut, but they warn about nuts in general: Cats Protection says nuts can cause problems for cats, and VCA says most nuts are very fatty and can cause vomiting and diarrhoea. Macadamia nuts are the exception that is also toxic.
why.sl: Naši viri tega oreščka ne omenjajo posebej, opozarjajo pa na oreščke na splošno: Cats Protection navaja, da oreščki mačkam lahko povzročajo težave, VCA pa, da je večina oreščkov zelo mastnih in lahko povzroči bruhanje in drisko. Izjema so makadamije, ki so tudi strupene.

en: Seeming unwell or low on energy
sl: Mačka deluje bolna ali brez energije

what_to_do.en: A nut or two is unlikely to be an emergency. Watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or a change in behaviour, and call your vet if your cat seems unwell or ate a lot. If the nuts were salted, flavoured or coated in chocolate, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: En ali dva oreščka najverjetneje ne pomenita nujnega primera. Bodite pozorni na bruhanje, drisko ali spremembo vedenja in pokličite veterinarja, če se mačka ne počuti dobro ali je pojedla veliko. Če so bili oreščki soljeni, začinjeni ali obliti s čokolado, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

child.en: Hazelnuts are a snack for people. Nuts can upset a cat's tummy, so keep them for yourself.
child.sl: Lešniki so prigrizek za ljudi. Oreščki lahko mucki razdražijo trebušček, zato jih obdrži zase.

q.en: Are some nuts worse than others?
q.sl: Ali so nekateri oreščki hujši od drugih?

a.en: Yes. Macadamia nuts are fatty and also toxic to cats, so they are the ones to be most careful with.
a.sl: Da. Makadamije so mastne in za mačke tudi strupene, zato je pri njih potrebna največja previdnost.

sources.quote: Some foods that may seem harmless, such as grapes, nuts or avocado, can also cause problems for cats.
Most nuts are very fatty and can cause vomiting and diarrhea, but macadamia nuts specifically will lead to weakness, tremors and hyperthermia.
Nuts such as macadamia, almonds and walnuts contain high amounts of oils and fats which if eaten can make your cat unwell
Not only are macadamia nuts very fatty, potentially causing pancreatitis, they're also toxic and can cause illness in cats.
